title: Freeze FastAPI/OpenAPI and authentication contract
objective: Compare the actual FastAPI routes and generated OpenAPI with the requested caregiver/patient flows, identify exact gaps, and define the smallest safe contract before frontend code.
acceptance_criteria: Every requested caregiver and patient capability maps to an exact route or a named gap
Supabase caregiver authority and patient device-token boundaries are explicit
Game idempotency and overview freshness are verified from source
Frontend contracts do not invent unsupported fields or success semantics
required_tests: Compare OpenAPI operations and schemas with route source and tests

result.summary: OpenAPI 3.1.0 generated and route/source audit completed. Supabase auth cutover is required.
